The late returns (19:10, 22:10) and flexible Saturday/Sunday timings support a hybrid/creative role rather than a rigid 9-5.

The probability is lower than the Hybrid model because the 'elsewhere' event is too specific to be just 'remote work prep' without further evidence of desk usage.
